key_insight: The paper introduces an automated, ontology-grounded pipeline that generates multiple-choice benchmarks with reasoner-verified correct answers and formally checked distractors for testing LLM reasoning.
engineering_relevance: This enables more reliable evaluation of LLMs used in scientific AI and materials informatics, where logical correctness over structured knowledge is critical.
method: Generate MCQs directly from sufficiently axiomatised OWL 2 ontologies.
Create distractors by perturbing right-hand-side class expressions in class definition axioms.
Use an OWL reasoner to verify that distractors are indeed incorrect via entailment checks.
evidence_signal: The pipeline produced 112, 2,491, and 15,216 MCQs for Pizza, PMDco, and DOID, and six zero-shot LLMs scored 41.1–76.8% accuracy, well above the 25% random baseline.
watch_item: Benchmark quality depends on ontology completeness and axiomatisation, so weaker or sparse ontologies may limit coverage and distractor diversity.
paper_title: Ontology-Grounded, Reasoner-Verified Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Reasoning in Scientific AI
